selectapp.headline: Cross-stack work across a mobility and assistance ecosystem, from mobile applications to AWS production releases.
bullets: End-to-end development with iOS (Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit), Flutter/Dart, React/TypeScript/Vite, and a Node.js/MySQL/AWS backend.
Implemented and maintained authentication, maps, and geolocation flows using MapKit/CoreLocation, location permissions, address search, and responsive behavior across web and mobile.
Integrated REST APIs and WebSockets, maintained client-server contracts, handled errors, and supported schema migrations and data reconciliation with MySQL/Amazon RDS.
Contributed to context-oriented architecture, feature flags, and backward-compatible transitions between versions.
Managed staging/production releases with preflight checks, readiness validation, smoke tests, canary rollouts, rollback, and root-cause analysis; deployed frontend applications through S3/CloudFront.

thifi.headline: Technical leadership and full-stack development across digital products, combining architecture, cloud, product, and UX/UI.
bullets: Coordinated architecture, frontend, backend, cloud, integrations, documentation, and collaboration across engineering, design, and product.
On IMOB, evolved frontend/backend systems, authentication and user management with Amazon Cognito, and infrastructure as code with CloudFormation/AWS CLI.
Performed type checks, builds, automated tests, and smoke tests; investigated backend failures, applied patches, and validated runtime behavior before releases.
On OneMedia, developed features with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and Firebase, including integrations with Google Maps, Instagram, WhatsApp Business, and payment gateways.

hapvida.headline: Developed iOS features for a healthcare product in collaboration with innovation, product, and design teams.
bullets: Implemented and maintained the digital prescription module and evolved critical application journeys.
Integrated REST APIs, handled state management and errors, and improved reliability across critical flows.
Applied Apple Human Interface Guidelines and accessibility best practices to patient and healthcare professional journeys.
